test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Raza requested his parents to forgive him that time and promised never to play truant again.

options.text: Raza said to his parents, “Please forgive me that time. I promise to never play truant again.”
Raza said to his parents, “Forgive me that time. I promise I would never play truant again.”
Raza said to his parents, “Forgive me this time. I promised never to play truant again.”
Raza said to his parents, “Please forgive me this time. I promise never to play truant again.”

solution:
The correct answer is **'Raza said to his parents, “Please forgive me this time. I promise never to play truant again.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change from *indirect to direct speech*, we use the following steps - 

 
 
• The reporting verb requested is changed to **said. **
 
• Put a comma (,) after 'Raza said to his parents...'
 
• Remove the conjunction that.
 
• Insert inverted commas ("...") to mark the statement part of the direct speech.
 
• Since the **reporting verb is requested** , the sentence is imperative and the statement part should begin with **please**.
 
• Capitalize the first word of the statement. (Please)
 
• Change past tense forms (that) of reporting verbs into present tense forms (this).
 
• Change past tense (promised) into present tense (promise).
 
 
 
• When we follow the above steps, we get the following sentence - Raza said to his parents, “Please forgive me this time. I promise never to play truant again."
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.
